title: A company-level opportunity to examine
description: Artifactory connects a sensing ambition with photonic design tooling. An investment discussion should consider the distinct maturity, evidence and risks of ArtiSense and AIFIELD before drawing a company-level conclusion.
lead: Artifactory connects a sensing ambition with photonic design tooling. An investment discussion should consider the distinct maturity, evidence and risks of ArtiSense and AIFIELD before drawing a company-level conclusion.

sections.heading: Where the work stands
body: The supplied material supports describing research, design, simulation and proposed architectures. It does not establish a current funding round, commercial traction, clinical validation, ownership position or a numeric ask. These points require direct confirmation.

sections.heading: Questions worth asking
body: For ArtiSense, the key gate is repeatable measured sensing performance and integration. For AIFIELD, it is a reproducible account of tool capability, limits and user value. Both require current plans, resources and milestones confirmed by the company.

sections.heading: Start a focused conversation
body: Use the investment enquiry to request current evidence, stage and next milestones for the company as a whole. The form records a local test receipt in this preview; actual investor communication requires the company’s verified contact channel.
